protocol.cv: not run — each fit takes minutes on CPU; single holdout with early stopping
protocol.threshold: decision threshold chosen to maximise F1 on training-side predictions (out-of-fold or validation), never on the test set
protocol.note: All scaling/encoding/resampling fitted inside the fold, never before the split.
protocol.resampling: weights=1: training batches sampled with inverse class frequency (inside the training split only)
protocol.validation: 15% of train held out for early stopping and threshold

majority_class.note: Always predict 'no'. Every accuracy figure must be read against this row.
